title: Worlds Without Bounds
description: Vanilla+ experience with a focus on world generation and building
body:
This modpack has the following main features:
* a beautiful world with a huge amount of biomes, stunning landscapes and interesting structures
* a "Minecraft 2.0" vibe with large render distances (via DistantHorizons) and shaders
* an extensive collection of building blocks and decoration options
* interesting mechanics and non-tech automation via the Create Mod
* expanded cooking with Farmer's Delight
* convenience features like inventory sorting, minimap, Waystones, etc.
